title: Genuine police call: passport verification
label: genuine
notes: Hard negative: a real police station calls, but asks the person to visit in person; no accusation, no secrecy, no money.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Namaste, main Kotwali police station se constable Ramesh bol raha hoon.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Aapne passport ke liye apply kiya tha, uska police verification karna hai.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Kal subah 11 baje thane aa jaiye, Aadhaar card aur address proof ki original copy le aana.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Agar kal nahi aa sakte toh parso aa jaana, koi dikkat nahi. Dhanyavaad.
